datasets.title: BeOpen
datasets.description: Set of High Value Datasets (HVDs) developed in BeOpen EU project that are open data collections selected for their high reuse potential. They were developed to support the creation of innovative public services across Europe, of Open Data provided by the public sector of many European cities. Available in open, machine-readable formats, they promote interoperability and API-based access and address mobility, urban security, environment, and natural disasters challenges in several EU regions.

datasets.title: Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue
datasets.description: Official Catalogue of Inspire Data and Services (CODSI) provides access INSPIRE data sets, HVD and network services. This catalogue is connected via harvesting or file interchange with the catalogues of national and regional public organisations, is the base for the monitoring process and for feeding the INSPIRE Geoportal. The INSPIRE Geoportal harvests metadata on 15 December each year. This Catalogue has Spain's official HVD in the categories of Geospatial, Earth Observation, Environment and Mobility.

datasets.title: CREST citizen survey on city resilience to climate change
datasets.description:
CREST is a research project, led by AugmentCity, that applied digital twins for demonstration, co-creation and mobilization of stakeholders for capacity-building and collective decision-making in 3 European urban areas (Bordeaux, France; Kristiansund, Norway; Kolobrzeg, Poland) for resilient urban infrastructure adaptation to climate change.

CREST conducted a citizen survey in the 3 urban areas to assess citizen perceptions on climate change and climate change resilience in their cities, the results of which are enclosed in Microsoft Excel format.
